counts_are: Yosys proc/memory_map/opt register Q bits; not mapped CTS sinks or measured insertion
blocking_seams: Controller combinational oh/gnt crosses into lane state; no launch/pin-capture registers. Adding two registers without an outstanding-grant protocol duplicates or misaligns grants.
Lane lane_sector output is bf[pa] mux rather than a registered face. Registering changes selection/data alignment and requires valid/X1 pricing.
Tag-sector metadata, format, reset/config cross tile pins without local registered capture.
Controller mv_rdy/id_rdy and outgoing completion/valid need actual pin audit; no physical outlines or placement are accepted.
Clock mean/spread/SSFF/DRC/child_lint and actual die slots are unmeasured.
bench_source_notes: Final run roots.otrun.log uses all mandatory controller/lane/slice clock pins; distinct pins are driven by the same ideal testbench clock. No physical CTS claim.
